title: Poincaré sphere engineering of dynamical ferroelectric topological solitons
method_class: second-principles / effective-Hamiltonian MD (light-driven); replicated at field-topology level
verdict: REPLICATED (field-topology level): all 4 topological-charge claims reproduced. Equator 2theta=90 -> Q=0 (vortex); tilt 2theta=75 -> antiskyrmion Q=-1; conjugate winding -> skyrmion Q=+1; intermediate 2theta=70 -> hybrid with spatially-split +1/-1 lobes, net Q=0. Berg-Luscher gives exact integers; FD integral confirms smooth crossover. Not a second-principles MD reproduction (energetics/dynamics/exact transition boundaries out of scope).
